reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Code at L51/L53 of user.move divides by spot_price_value in both branches rather than ema_price_value as the property specifies, making the effective tolerance ~11.1% instead of 10% when spot > EMA. An attacker can trigger this via flash loan by inflating the spot price to ~10.5% above EMA — the code formula yields (10.5/110.5 ≈ 9.5%) which passes the 10% gate, whereas the correct formula (10.5/100 = 10.5%) would reject it — allowing borrow/withdraw operations in an oracle state the circuit breaker was designed to block. Severity adjusted from Critical to High because direct financial harm requires additional exploitation steps beyond the bypass, since valuations remain EMA-based throughout.
